meta.name: verify
meta.description: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动应用自动验证,录制全程视频并打开摘要页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要自动驱动应用运行并留下验证记录视频。
copy.tagline_en: Drive an app headlessly, record its verification, and open a summary page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate app verification and capture a video record

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude在后台运行一个图形应用，把整个验证过程录成视频，并生成一个包含操作时间线、检查结果和截图的总结页面，最后自动打开它。
howto.when: 当用户要求验证应用的界面行为（如点击、滚动、输入），或需要一份带录制视频的检查报告时触发。

say.text: 验证这个应用的滚轮功能，给我看录屏和检查结果。
say.note: 会无头运行并录制，最后打开总结页面。

say.text: 写个脚本测试点击与输入，并生成验证报告。
say.note: 脚本运行后会在摘要页显示每步通过或失败。

say.text: 无头运行这个应用，录下视频并打开摘要页。
say.note: 最终会打开包含视频、时间线和检查项的页面。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude run a GUI app headlessly, record the whole verification as a video, and generate a summary page with timeline, checks, and stills, then open it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to verify an app's UI behavior (e.g. click, scroll, typing) or to have a recorded verification report with pass/fail checks.

say_en.text: Verify this app's scrolling, show me the recording and check results.
say_en.note: It will run headless, record, and open the summary page.

say_en.text: Write a script testing clicks and typing, then generate a verification report.
say_en.note: The summary page shows which steps passed or failed.

say_en.text: Run this app headless, record a video, and open the summary page.
say_en.note: Opens a page with video, timeline, and checks.
